notes: Sepolia rehearsal (chain id 11155111, selected by the deployment service). Deploy MockCoin first, then Ochre, with zero ETH and no initialization calls. MockCoin is Pigment/PGMT with 18 decimals; its constructor mints 1000000000 PGMT to the specified admin, and anyone may mint rehearsal coins. Ochre arguments are coin, admin, adam, seatRoot, startTime, then seven right-zero-padded ASCII bytes32 cave labels. The brief's fixed address receives MockCoin's initial supply, holds Ochre's admin privileges, and receives ids 0 and 736; the factory receives no privileges. Start time is fixed at 1791352835. The repeated-0x11 seat root is a rehearsal placeholder with no supplied valid proofs and cannot be changed after deployment. Ochre compiles in coin decimals 18, dead address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, start price 400000 and floor price 40000; prices are literal coin base units, not multiplied by 10^18. The 737 NFTs comprise 2 constructor mints, 400 sale pieces, 315 seats and 20 admin reserve pieces. Buyers approve Ochre; purchase payments go directly from buyer to dead. Anyone may release unclaimed seats after 8 days; this closes claims and makes those pieces available at the floor after each cave's original sale pieces. Admin can mint the reserve and freeze each cave's metadata prefix once. Neither contract is upgradeable, pausable or Ownable. This manifest specifies deployment inputs; it does not record a completed deployment.
